title: Fear and Loathing on the Frontline: Decoding the Language of Othering by Russia-Ukraine War Bloggers
reasoning: The paper includes a substantial section dedicated to 'The Moral Language of Othering.' It utilizes Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) to categorize and analyze language according to human intuitive ethics—such as purity, authority, equality, and care—to understand how these moral frames justify and intensify intergroup conflict and othering.
